name: Sandy
source: A country girl from California and Daisy's childhood friend. Sandy grew up around the kind of hard work nobody applauds: getting up early, fixing things with whatever is at hand, and not flinching when life turns ugly. She rides horses, repairs what breaks and handles trouble without drama.
